subject: planner,expression: Limit projection pushed down scope to avoid potential performance degression (#53650)
summary: Diff vs parent: adds `expression.ProjectionBenefitsFromPushedDown()` to strictly gate Projection-to-TiKV pushdown (column-pruning only for pure column projections; otherwise only selected JSON functions, with `JSONUnquote` limited to the `->>`-style pattern), and wires this gate into `LogicalProjection.ExhaustPhysicalPlans()` when generating `CopSingleReadTaskType` candidates. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/session/privilege/concurrency; change is a tightening condition so results should remain unchanged while avoiding bad plan choices/perf regressions. Later history up to `upstream/master` keeps this logic (only a debug failpoint was added later), with no follow-up fix indicating a defect.
